_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cruise-line signals

pit_profile.why: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, these six brands operate a combined 44 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 110,900 berths as of December 31, 2015'; 'We compete principally on the basis of exceptional service provided by our crew, innovation and quality of ships, variety of itineraries, choice of destinations and price'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'The demand for cruises is affected by international, national and local economic and geopolitical conditions' (its own FY2015 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, these six brands operate a combined 44 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 110,900 berths as of December 31, 2015'; 'We compete principally on the basis of exceptional service provided by our crew, innovation and quality of ships, variety of itineraries, choice of destinations and price'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'The demand for cruises is affected by international, national and local economic and geopolitical conditions' (its own FY2015 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 1.53x; +4% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.89; conservative 2yr +35%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -73.5%/yr (worst year FY06-FY15, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +5.3%/yr (Q3 cc guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +5.7%/yr (FY06-FY15 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +97.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY06-FY15); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: RCL (retrospective, 2016-10-21) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.53x (94.2% downside to Bear $4 / +61.5% upside to Bull $112) | Adj composite 2.83 vs market 1.94: gap +0.89 [UNDERVALUED] | +4% above the EPP floor $67 (11x FY16E $6.05) | Conservative 2-yr case: +34.7% total (+17.4%/yr) | At 11.5x FY16E the 15% hurdle price $92 sits at or below the BASE case; Net Yields -0.5% in Q2 2016, forward net revenue +5.26% (Q3 2016 net revenue guide at constant currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
